learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn all about the amazing games and fun activities we enjoy doing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Playing games with our friends is the best feeling. We can run jump and laugh out loud.
Sometimes singing a sweet song or clapping our hands is also a lot of fun. We all have different ways to enjoy.

fun_activity.title: 🎶 The Fun Action Game
fun_activity.instructions: When your mom or dad says Jump you jump! When they say Spin you spin! Play this fun game for five minutes.

quick_recap: ⭐ We have fun when we play jump and run.
⭐ Doing things with friends makes us very happy.
